body:
# ⚔️ Piece – Advanced RPG Combat System (v1.0)

**Piece** transforms your Minecraft server into a competitive MMORPG-style PvP experience built around progression, races, stamina-based combat, bounty hunting, and boss challenges.

Designed for Minecraft 1.21, the plugin focuses on **balanced PvP, rewarding progression, and clean visual polish** — without unnecessary complexity.

---

## 🆙 Level & XP System

- Players gain XP from mobs and PvP.
- Mobs spawn with levels.
- XP scales based on level difference.
- Player level appears next to their name.
- `/level` shows XP progress to the next level.
- XP bar dynamically updates in real time.

Progression feels meaningful and competitive.

---

## 📊 Stat Investment System

Earn stat points as you level up and build your own combat style:

- **Melee** → Increased stamina efficiency & combat performance  
- **Movement** → Increased speed & jump (balanced caps)  
- **Defense** → Increased max HP & damage resistance  

### Commands
- `/stat deposit <melee/movement/defense>`
- `/stat view`
- `/stat reset`

No skill trees — full freedom to create your own build.

---

## 🧬 5 Unique Races (Awakened from Start)

Upon first join, players are randomly assigned one of five races (20% each).

All races are automatically awakened — no grind required.

### Available Races
- Human  
- Crocodile / Megalodon  
- Vampire  
- Infernal  
- Werewolf  

Each race includes:
- Passive buffs
- Unique combat advantages
- Visual identity
- Balanced PvP impact

Races can be rerolled using **Fragments of Origin** dropped from the Warden.

---

## ⚡ Stamina & Dash System

Combat is skill-based, not spam-based.

- Double tap **W** to Dash.
- Dash consumes stamina and hunger.
- Cooldowns prevent abuse.
- Movement stat reduces dash cost and increases efficiency.
- Stamina displayed in action bar.

Running out of stamina reduces combat effectiveness.

---

## 💰 Bounty System

Kill streaks trigger automatic server-wide bounties.

- Bounty targets glow.
- XP bar shows distance tracking.
- `/bounty` displays active targets.

Killing a bounty rewards:
- Bonus XP
- Honor
- Fragment of Origin

Encourages PvP hunting and high-risk gameplay.

---

## 🎖 Honor & Rank System

Earn Honor from:
- Boss kills (Warden, Wither, Ender Dragon)
- PvP (scaled by level difference)

Lose 2% Honor on death to prevent farming.

Ranks automatically update and display in:
- Chat
- Tab list
- Above player name

---

## 🏷 Title System

Unlock titles through achievements such as:
- Player kills
- Boss kills
- Milestones

### Commands
- `/titles view`
- `/titles equip <title>`
- `/titles unequip`

Legendary titles glow and display above the player.

---

## 👹 Enhanced Boss Difficulty

Bosses are improved for endgame challenge:
- Harder fights
- Better scaling
- Increased reward value

Piece is built to make late-game survival challenging.

---

# 🎮 Why Choose Piece?

✔ MMO-style progression  
✔ Balanced stat builds  
✔ Skill-based stamina combat  
✔ Competitive bounty hunting  
✔ Unique race identity  
✔ Clean visuals without performance issues  
✔ Hardcore boss encounters  

---

**Piece v1.0** delivers a complete RPG combat framework designed for competitive survival and PvP servers.
